ON THE 16 th OF JANUARY, 2024  MISC. CRIMINAL CASE No. 55845 of 2023

BETWEEN:-
 CHANDER SHEKHER S/O PANNALAL VERMA, AGED

ABOUT 35 YEARS, R/O VILLAGE AND POST KHINHUA PS  PANWADI DISTRICT MAHOBA (U.P. )
 
 (SHRI NITIN GOYAL - ADVOCATE)
 AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH THE  STATION HOUSE OFFICER OF KOTWALI, DISTRICT  SHIVPURI (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 ( SHRI APS TOMAR - PANEL LAWYER FOR STATE)
 This application coming on for hearing this day, the   following:
 ORDER
The applicant has filed this first application u/S 439, Cr.P.C. for grant of bail.

The applicant has been arrested by Police Station Kotwali, District Shivpuri in connection with Crime No. 308/2023 for the offence punishable under Sections 420, 406, 409, 120-B of IPC read with 6(1) of Nikshepakon ke hiton ka sanrakshan adhiniyam, 2000.
Learned counsel for the applicant argued that applicant is an innocent person and has been falsely implicated.
It is further submitted that allegedly them amount was transferred through Phone-pe on the account of applicant/accused.
Further, there is no evidence on record to show the said transfer by Phone-pe by the victims.
Further submission is that co-accused Akhilesh Kumar Rajput has already been granted bail by the trial Court.
Further submission is that the applicant is in custody since 3.6.2023.
After conclusion of investigation, charge-sheet has already been filed.

Therefore,

Under the circumstances, he prayed for grant of bail.
On the other hand, learned State counsel vehemently opposed the application citing the criminal history of the applicant/accused and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for the rival parties and perused the case diary available on record.

Looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, without commenting upon the merits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes a cash security of Rs.100,000/- (rupees One Lakh) with one local solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court, he should be released on bail.

5) The applicant will not seek unnecessary adjournments during the trial; and 6) The applicant will not leave India without previous permission of the trial Court/Investigating Officer, as the case may be.
(7) The applicant shall mark his presence before the SHO of the concerning Police Station in the first week of every month till conclusion of trial.
Learned State counsel is directed to send an e-copy of this order to the Station House Officer of the concerned Police Station for information and necessary action.
E- copy of this order be sent to the trial Court concerned for compliance, if possible, by the office of this Court.
Certified copy as per rules.
